component.name: S226 Heart Rate
component.summary: Heart rate, settings and activity from the S226 watch

description.p: Connects to an S226 (H-Band / Veepoo) fitness watch over Bluetooth LE and exposes the watch through tabs: live heart rate and cadence, settings, alarms, notifications (including music and desktop notification forward), activity history, sleep and sport-mode workouts.

ul.li: Large live heart-rate display with optional metronome
Graph of heart rate and cadence over 1 minute to 2 hours
Daily CSV log of every reading
Read and change watch settings, alarms and message types
Music now-playing, optional MPRIS bridge, desktop notification forward
Fetch 5-minute activity history, sleep sessions and sport-mode workouts

description.p: The app talks to a USB Bluetooth controller directly over raw HCI instead of going through BlueZ, so it needs read/write access to the controller's USB device node.
First version of the graphical heart-rate app.
